beats.text: At dawn, Rama came to greet his father, expecting a blessing for his coronation. He found him broken, unable even to speak.
'What has happened, mother?' asked Rama. 'Have I displeased my father?'
Kaikeyi told him everything: the two boons, the throne for Bharata, the forest for him.
Rama did not argue or frown. 'If my father's word needs it, I go gladly,' he said. 'Why would I need the crown when I have his honor?'
He went to his mother Kaushalya. She fainted with grief, and begged to come with him.
Lakshmana raged and wanted to fight for the throne. Rama calmed him. 'This is destiny,' he said. 'No one is to blame.'
Rama took off his silk and jewels and put on clothes of tree bark.
He gave up a kingdom as easily as one lets go of a flower.
